If sentiment is consistently positive (≥0.67) in the last 3 days, reduce forecast by 1.5–2.5% for early horizon (1–7 days) to avoid over-optimism.  
If sentiment is consistently negative (≤0.33) in the last 3 days, increase forecast by 1.5–2.5% for mid horizon (8–15 days) to counteract pessimism.  
When sentiment swings from positive to negative within 3 days, shift forecast downward by 2–3% in the 10–14 day window to reflect sentiment reversal.  
If sentiment is neutral (0.33–0.67) and price is trending upward, reduce forecast by 0.5–1.0% for late horizon (16–30 days) to prevent overcorrection.  
If sentiment is neutral and price is trending downward, increase forecast by 0.5–1.0% for late horizon to offset downward momentum.  
If sentiment is positive but price is declining, reduce forecast by 1.0–2.0% in the 7–10 day window to align with sentiment-price divergence.
